scope: Text-only manual review. No original audio or Typeless A/B. Automatic flags are not semantic grades. Main corpus was used to tune the prompt.

additional_findings.register-v7: holdout_training 반복 2에서 생략된 선택 대상을 일정으로 바꿔 채움.
additional_findings.final: 온도 0으로 낮춘 Ollama 일반 구조화 받아쓰기. 30문장 64회(26×2 + 4×3). 형식 경고 5회, 요청/조건/이름/말투 변경은 이 표본의 검토에서 발견하지 못했다. 형식 경고는 통과로 숨기지 않았다.

validation.prompt_export: Shipping export equals evaluated v8 JSON; only structured-false and structured-true differ from baseline.
validation.request_body: Mock HTTP integration verifies temperature 0 is serialized for Ollama/Gemma structured dictation before validated streaming output.
limitations: One local model, text-only, no live voice/STT or external chat insertion test
Development data and initially separate cases were used for refinement; no final unseen/blind score
Default style stays clean; scenes still override structure; remote providers and GLM-specific temperature overrides differ
Whole-repository cargo fmt --check has pre-existing unrelated differences; changed h_polish/openai files and git diff whitespace checks passed
